verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev supports named API keys per environment and personal access tokens for its management API, which offers some credential separation (e.g., per-environment secretKey), but there is no evidence of true scoped/least-privilege permissions (e.g., restricting a key to specific tasks, read-only access, or agent-specific scopes). missing for 10: fine-grained scope/permission controls on API keys, documentation of least-privilege key issuance for agents specifically, and any audit/rotation tooling tied to agent credentials.
